# Screener Specification

## Source Intent
Biggest green candle from daily candle body for the last 30 days, should be eligible for buy, skip others.

## Universe
NIFTY 200

## Dates and Candle Timeframe
Daily candles, scanning a date range with the last 60 trading sessions.

## Conditions
- The body range (open - close) of the candle should be the biggest of the last 30 available candles.
- The candle must be green (close > open).

## Direction
- **BUY**: Only green candles are considered eligible for buy.

## Filters
None specified yet.

## Sort Order
Volume descending.

## Output Fields
- stock
- direction
- close
- volume

## Validation
Acceptance: must return RELIANCE for the daily candle closing on 2026-11-02 IST; must not return it for previous candles.

## Parameters
None specified yet.

## Date Scope
- Mode: range
- Default days: 60

## Attached Chart Verification

Replay the confirmed conditions at each marked candle's OPEN timestamp in IST. Use the attached PNG as visual evidence, not as a substitute for real candle and indicator history.

| Chart / Mark | Symbol | Date/time (IST) | Interval | Expected output |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| clmw269gh08z / mkmw269ex88t | RELIANCE | 2026-11-02T00:00 | daily | Included at this candle |

A successful verification requires every SIGNAL to appear and every AVOID to be absent at the specified symbol, timestamp and timeframe. No skipped/xfail tests or missing-data passes. Record the actual matched rows, evaluated condition values, test command and pass/fail output. Passing these samples verifies the attached examples, not profitability or all future signals.

conditions: (close - open) = max(close - open) over last 30 candles

direction.neutral: Matches neither the BUY rule nor the SELL rule
